title: Show HN: Voyager 1 tour goes down to individual memory chips
summary: Raj Shekhar posted an interactive Voyager 1 breakdown that lets visitors inspect the spacecraft&\#x27;s systems at component level, including its nuclear battery&\#x27;s 24 plutonium spheres and the data computer&\#x27;s individual memory chips. The site also shows where both Voyagers are now, which Earth dish is listening live, how the Golden Record&\#x27;s cover explains playback, and includes a four-minute film. Shekhar presented it as Voyager 1 reached one light-day from Earth today.
